arxiv-2003-10412.title: What is Normal, What is Strange, and What is Missing in a Knowledge Graph: Unified Characterization via Inductive Summarization Conference: Proceedings of The Web Conference 2020; April 20–24, 2020; Taipei, Taiwan Proceedings of The Web Conference 2020 (WWW ’20), April 20–24, 2020, Taipei, Taiwan DO
arxiv-2003-10412.creator: Caleb Belth, Xinyi Zheng, Jilles Vreeken, Danai Koutra
arxiv-2003-10412.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Caleb Belth, Xinyi Zheng, Jilles Vreeken, Danai Koutra. Knowledge graphs (KGs) store highly heterogeneous information about the world in the structure of a graph, and are useful for tasks such as question answering and reasoning. However, they often contain errors and are missing information. Vibrant research in KG refinement has worked to resolve these issues, tailoring techniques to either detect specific types of errors or complete a KG.

arxiv-2405-09531.title: Ticket-based multi-strand method for increased efficiency in proof-of-work based blockchains
arxiv-2405-09531.creator: Elias Rudberg
arxiv-2405-09531.description: Abstract This paper outlines a method aiming to increase the efficiency of proof-of-work based blockchains using a ticket-based approach. To avoid the limitation of serially adding one block at a time to a blockchain, multiple semi-independent chains are used such that several valid blocks can be added in parallel, when they are added to separate chains.

arxiv-2406-07909.title: Guiding Frame-Level CTC Alignments Using Self-knowledge Distillation Thanks: * Work done during internship at NAVER Cloud. Thanks: † Corresponding author.
arxiv-2406-07909.creator: Eungbeom Kim, Hantae Kim, Kyogu Lee
arxiv-2406-07909.description: Abstract Transformer encoder with connectionist temporal classification (CTC) framework is widely used for automatic speech recognition (ASR). However, knowledge distillation (KD) for ASR displays a problem of disagreement between teacher-student models in frame-level alignment which ultimately hinders it from improving the student model’s performance.

arxiv-2410-03539.title: Moments of Axial-Vector GPD from Lattice QCD: Quark Helicity, Orbital Angular Momentum, and Spin-Orbit Correlation
arxiv-2410-03539.creator: Shohini Bhattacharya, Krzysztof Cichy, Martha Constantinou, Xiang Gao, Andreas Metz, Joshua Miller, Swagato Mukherjee, Peter Petreczky, Fernanda Steffens, Yong Zhao
arxiv-2410-03539.description: Abstract In this work, we present a lattice QCD calculation of the Mellin moments of the twist-2 axial-vector generalized parton distribution (GPD), H ~ ​ ( x , ξ , t ) \widetilde{H}(x,\xi,t) , at zero skewness, ξ \xi , with multiple values of the momentum transfer, t t .

arxiv-2410-22167.title: Kinetic Inductance and nonlinearity of MgB 2 Films at 4K
arxiv-2410-22167.creator: J. Greenfield, C. Bell, F. Faramarzi, C. Kim, R. Basu Thakur, A. Wandui, C. Frez, P. Mauskopf, D. Cunnane
arxiv-2410-22167.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by J. Greenfield, C. Bell, F. Faramarzi, C. Kim, R. Basu Thakur, A. Wandui, C. Frez, P. Mauskopf, D. Cunnane. We report on the fabrication and characterization of superconducting magnesium diboride (MgB 2 ) thin films intended for quantum-limited devices based non-linear kinetic inductance (NLKI) such as parametric amplifiers with either elevated operating temperatures or expanded frequency ranges.

arxiv-2412-16306.title: Dependence of convective precipitation extremes on near-surface relative humidity
arxiv-2412-16306.creator: Robert J. van der Drift \aff a Paul A. O’Gorman \aff a
arxiv-2412-16306.description: Abstract Precipitation extremes produced by convection have been found to intensify with near-surface temperatures at a Clausius-Clapeyron rate of 6 6 to 7 % 7\% K -1 in simulations of radiative-convective equilibrium (RCE). However, these idealized simulations are typically performed over an ocean surface with a high near-surface relative humidity (RH) that stays roughly constant with warming.

europmc-pmc8863574.creator: Patone M, Mei XW, Handunnetthi L, Dixon S, Zaccardi F, Shankar-Hari M, Watkinson P, Khunti K, Harnden A, Coupland CAC, Channon KM, Mills NL, Sheikh A, Hippisley-Cox J.
europmc-pmc8863574.description: Although myocarditis and pericarditis were not observed as adverse events in coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) vaccine trials, there have been numerous reports of suspected cases following vaccination in the general population. We undertook a self-controlled case series study...

pmc-10509087.title: Undifferentiated pleomorphic sarcoma of the spleen: a case report and literature review
pmc-10509087.creator: Raphael Gatt, Luca Casingena, David Pisani, Rachel Agius, Noel Cassar
pmc-10509087.description: BackgroundUndifferentiated pleomorphic sarcoma is an uncommon sarcoma and its presence in the spleen is even rarer, with only a handful of cases reported in English literature. It is typically only diagnosed following histological analysis. Its rarity also means that there is little consensus over ideal management.

pmc-10680544.title: Синдром переустановки осмостата — когда гипонатриемия становится «нормой»: аспекты диагностики, описание клинического случая
pmc-10680544.creator: Л. И. Астафьева, И. Н. Бадмаева, И. С. Клочкова, Ю. Г. Сиднева, О. И. Шарипов, О. А. Гаджиева, Б. А. Баширян, П. Л. Калинин, А. Ю. Лубнин, А. Н. Коновалов
pmc-10680544.description: Синдром переустановки осмостата (СПО) характеризуется изменением нормального порога осмоляльности плазмы (уменьшением или повышением), что приводит к развитию хронической диснатриемии (гипо- или гипернатриемии). Мы описали клинический случай развития СПО, сопровождающегося хронической гипонатриемией, у пациентки с хордоидной глиомой III желудочка. Известно, что у пациентки ранее выявлялась гипонатриемия (131–134 ммоль/л). В ходе обследования были исключены гипотиреоз и гипокортицизм.

pmc-11495589.title: Arabic consonant length perception depends on the relative speech rate of the distal context
pmc-11495589.creator: Christopher C. Heffner, Buthainah M. Al-Thowaini, C. Anton Rytting
pmc-11495589.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Listeners adapt to the speech rate of talkers. Many studies of speech rate adaptation have focused on the influence of rate information on the perception of word segmentation or segmental perception in English. The effects of immediately adjacent (i.e., proximal) information are generally strong on the perception of both segments and segmentation, but the effects of rate information temporally remote from (i.e., distal to) ambiguous speech signals are less clear, especially for segments.

pmc-12408218.title: Huge hematoma following extracorporeal shock wave lithotripsy leading to nephrectomy
pmc-12408218.creator: Mehdi Dadpour, Jamal Sadr, Seyed Mohammad Hashem Montazeri, Mina Vishteh, Sina Poorsalimi, Hamidreza Samadpour
pmc-12408218.description: Extracorporeal shockwave lithotripsy (ESWL) is a noninvasive and relatively safe method for treating small urinary tract stones, however it may be accompanied with some important complications including hematoma. In this report, we review an instructive and rare case of a patient with massive renal hematoma following ESWL.

pmc-12557781.title: Epigenetic suppression of Nrf2–Slc40a1 axis induces ferroptosis and enhances immunotherapy in pancreatic cancer
pmc-12557781.creator: Yixuan Zhang, Ranran Yu, Qi Li, Shiyi Song, Yao Fu, Xinjie Shen, Tianqi Xu, Yin Zhang, Jiawei Liang, Ziying Zhang, Shijin Xu, Jiatong Tang, Yihan Zhao, Congqiang Shen, Yuhang Zhuang, Jiajun Zhang, Lei Wang, Xiaoping Zou, Dijun Chen, Ying Lv, Shu Zhang
pmc-12557781.description: BackgroundDespite progress in immunotherapy for several solid tumors, pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) remains largely unresponsive, primarily due to its profoundly immunosuppressive tumor microenvironment (TME) characterized by limited CD8+ T cell infiltration. Novel strategies are needed to overcome this immune resistance and enhance the efficacy of checkpoint blockade.

pmc-12597763.title: Advantages of Blunt Radiofrequency Needles in CT‐Guided Dorsal Root Ganglion Pulsed Radiofrequency for the Treatment of Zoster‐Associated Pain
pmc-12597763.creator: Guanghui Zhang, Jing Yang, Xin Yao, Kai Luo, Zhiji Chen, Shuxiu Feng, Chunfang Wang, Xiaolan Gao, Zelin Weng, Ronald G Pearl
pmc-12597763.description: ObjectiveCompare the clinical efficacy of CT‐guided blunt versus sharp needles for dorsal root ganglion‐pulsed radiofrequency (DRG‐PRF) in treating zoster‐associated pain (ZAP).MethodThis retrospective study analyzed 70 ZAP patients receiving CT‐guided DRG‐PRF between January 2021 and December 2024. Participants were divided into the blunt needle group (BNG, n = 30) and the sharp needle group (SNG, n = 40).

pmc-13000628.title: Mediating Factors and Well-Being Differences by Gender Among Academic Physicians
pmc-13000628.creator: Miriam T. Stewart, Mihriye Mete, Mariah Quinn, Chantal Brazeau, Kristine Olson, Susannah G. Rowe
pmc-13000628.description:
A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). This survey study compares factors that mediate associations of gender with occupational well-being among male and female physicians,

Introduction

Occupational distress is highly prevalent among physicians and its harms to physicians, patients, and health care organizations have been well-documented.1,2,3 Given these harms, clinician well-being has been conceptualized as one of the aims in the quintuple aim of the health care system,4 alongside improving population health, enhancing the patient experience of care, reducing health care costs, and promoting health equity.

pmc-13074902.title: MRI-Based Radiomics Reveals Cannabinoid-Associated Tumor Phenotypes in a Murine Breast Cancer Model
pmc-13074902.creator: Ioana Creanga-Murariu, Cosmin-Vasilica Pricope, Mitica Ciorpac, Debbie Anaby, Kfir Cohen, Cristina-Mariana Uritu, Andrei Szilagyi, Raluca-Maria Gogu, Wael Jalloul, Adriana-Elena Anita, Dragos-Constantin Anita, Radu-Andrei Baisan, Teodora Alexa-Stratulat, Bogdan-Ionel Tamba
pmc-13074902.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Introduction and Aim: Assessment of antitumor activity in preclinical models remains challenging when relying solely on conventional size-based imaging, particularly for complex agents such as cannabinoids, whose biological effects may not translate into early volumetric tumor changes. Cannabinoid formulations, including the synthetic cannabinoid JWH-182, Cannabixir® Medium dried flowers, and Cannabixir® THC full extract, exhibit diverse and potentially subtle effects on tumor biology. Radiomics enables high-throughput extraction of quantitative imaging features that capture intratumoral heterogeneity beyond gross tumor volume.

pmc-13289562.title: Oral alginate microspheres deliver Rg3/aspirin liposomes to modulate foam cells and gut microbiota in atherosclerosis
pmc-13289562.creator: Yong-bo Liu, Jing-tian Zhang, Jun-nan Hu, Shen Ren, De-yang Huo, Ling-jie Song, Wei Li
pmc-13289562.description: Atherosclerosis is a complex pathology driven by chronic inflammation, lipid accumulation, and thrombosis, necessitating multi-pathway therapeutic strategies. Herein, we engineered an oral multi-stage platform (RALM) comprising aspirin (Asp) and ginsenoside Rg3 co-loaded phosphatidylserine (PS) liposomes (RA-Lipo) encapsulated within sodium alginate microspheres.

pmc-13387927.title: Neurodevelopmental Disorder with Dystonia and Chorea Linked to De Novo Variants in the Splicing Regulator SRRM4
pmc-13387927.creator: Philip Harrer, Volker Kittke, Alice Saparov, Alexej Knaus, Shimriet Zeidler, Rachel Schot, Florian Kraft, Matthias Begemann, Suzanna Koudijs, Ugo Sorrentino, Chen Zhao, Ivana Dzinovic, Martin Pavlov, Elisabeth Graf, Antonia M Stehr, Peter M Krawitz, Christian Wilhelm, Saskia Biskup, Fahd Alsalloum,
pmc-13387927.description: Background SRRM4 is an exclusively neural‐expressed splicing‐factor gene not yet associated with a monogenic condition.ObjectiveWe sought to delineate movement disorders caused by SRRM4 variants. De novo splice‐donor‐site variants at position +2 of intron 5 of SRRM4 (c.464+2T>C, c.464+2T>A) occurred in three unrelated patients with dystonia and chorea.

pmc-13530071.title: Association between smile arc curvature and skeletal pattern in orthodontic patients: a retrospective cross-sectional analytical study
pmc-13530071.creator: Atheer Ganem, Meelaf Alshahrani, Noura Abumelha, Nahar Alqahtani, Rima Albishri, Lina Hafiz, Wajd AlDhafer, Norah Alamri
pmc-13530071.description: To evaluate the association between smile arc curvature, skeletal pattern, and maxillary incisor display among orthodontic patients attending King Khalid University College of Dentistry. This retrospective cross-sectional analytical study included 150 eligible orthodontic patients. Standardized pretreatment posed smile photographs and lateral cephalometric radiographs were analyzed. Smile arc curvature was classified as consonant, flat, or reverse.
